title: upgrading from Hogan templates to HTML tagged templates does not allow for custom attributes
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

using Hogan.js custom attributes were possible.  For example, adding custom click handler syntax to an anchor tag from 3rd party libraries like alpine.js   [https://alpinejs.dev/directives/on](url)
```

 instantsearch.widgets.hits({
     item (hit) { 

         return ' <a href="#" @click.prevent="$dispatch('show-modal', { itemno: '${hit.itemno}' })">'
...

```

Now when upgrading to  HTML templates due to Hogan deprecation (https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/upgrade-guides/js/?client=html+tagged+templates#upgrade-templates),  the following error is thrown:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/380230/212973379-5e50de77-5633-425a-acef-c7aafae5b22d.png)


### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

follow the upgrade guide to replace them either with safe HTML strings using the provided html tagged template, or JSX templates as described above

### Live reproduction

sandbox.dynaprice.com

### 💭 Expected behavior

allow for custom attributes on dom elements.

### Package version

"instantsearch.js": "^4.49.1"

### Operating system

Windows 10

### Browser

Chrome v. 109.0.5414.74

- [X] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct

comments.body: For now, a workaround would be using the spec-compliant `x-on` instead of `@`. I believe this is because we previously used innerHTML, while now setAttribute is used (and `@something` isn't a valid attribute)

thanks, will try that
We won't be able to find a solution for this unfortunately, as `setAttribute` is throwing. x-on or `onClick=${myFunction}` should be used instead.
